liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Comes A Time** (4 reviews): Starts from a complete standstill, then flows into an extended, pleasing jam; The jam coming out of it is fast and recalls Eyes of the World [8][9][16][18]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Includes a lyric about coming full circle, recalling when the whole suite was once performed; The Other One into Eyes and back into The Other One is singled out, followed by a second encore of Not Fade Away [8][11]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-07-17.157427.mtx.motb.0201.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd76-07-17.menke.minches.18389.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers the sound of this audience tape over the soundboard; Very distant audience recording; Somewhat hissy, but it is an audience tape and not the master [13][15][16]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell.sb25.95734.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 157 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell-bertrando.91827.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Donna was absent throughout the second set, yet the band sounded unaffected [10]
- Reviewer considers this a better-played show than the following night's [9]
- The next night may overshadow this show, but this one holds up on its own [10]
- Overshadowed by the following night's show, but reviewer says it deserves to be judged more broadly [11]
- Reviewer ranks it alongside a Boston Music Hall show, though with weaker sound and performance [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-07-17.157427.mtx.motb.0201.flac16**: taped by Taped By: Bob Menke; transferred by Transfer By: Bob Menke Mastering By: Derek McCabe; source: Analog Soundboard Source: gd76-07-17.sbd.34708 Analog Audience Source: ECM 280's 152 [1]
- **gd76-07-17.menke.minches.18389.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by David Minches; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-270s> Sony TC-152 from front of balcony [2]. Also: Lineage runs MAC to R to D to WAV to SHN, via David Minches [2]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell.sb25.95734.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [6]. Also: Soundboard fix of the 243 version: master reel to DAT to CD, fixed by Bill Tetzeli; Tetzeli's fix added a crossfaded patch in Eyes of the World; Matrix combines Menke's balcony audience recording with the soundboard, made by David Minches; Rob Bertrando suggested an earlier version [6]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell-bertrando.91827.sbeok.flac16**: taped by itch Correction & Slight Bass Boost processed by Rob Bertrando. Final matrix seed discs provided by Rob Betrando EAC > FLAC by Noah Weiner; source: Matrix Ratio: 60%(SBD) / 40%(AUD) [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Ticket - Orpheum Theatre S.F., CA 18 July 1976](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/ticket-orpheum-theatre-s-f-ca-18-july-1976) [21]
